`pdf-to-json` reads more real-world invoices.

- `pdf-to-json.wasm`: reads PDFs whose text is ASCII85-encoded over Flate, as ReportLab and some ERP and billing systems write them; these used to return `has_text: false`. Wide gaps between text on one line now come out as two spaces, so a two-column invoice header ("Invoice No: INV-24-0417  Invoice Date: 10.11.2026") and table rows stay readable by `key-value-extractor`. Single spaces in running text are unchanged.

The other modules are unchanged. Every file is built on GitHub from the tagged source, byte-identical to a local `./build.sh`, with `SHA256SUMS` and a signed build attestation.
